concerns.text: Phase 5.5 (WYSIATI & Confidence Metrics) contains tasks T051-T055 which have no corresponding User Story, Functional Requirement, or Success Criterion in spec.md or plan.md. The plan explicitly removed this content ('Phase 6 (WYSIATI metrics): Removed') citing Constitution Principle VI. These tasks represent scope creep and attempt to implement features not authorized by the spec.

Task T004b (Extract Empirical Outcome) and T021 (Valence Calculation) lack explicit [FR-NNN] or [SC-NNN] tags. While T004b describes logic for alias resolution, the spec (FR-004) and plan do not define a mechanism for categorical-to-numeric mapping or alias resolution. Without a spec anchor, this task implements an unverified assumption about data structure.

Task T024 (Mixed-Effects Regression) applies Holm-Bonferroni correction only to the 'primary hypothesis family' and excludes control variables. Spec FR-007 mandates correction 'when testing more than one hypothesis' without distinguishing primary vs. control. The task description does not map to a specific FR/SC that authorizes this exclusion, creating a potential violation of the spec's correction requirement.

Task T033 (Robustness Sweep) does not explicitly tag the specific Success Criterion SC-003 it satisfies, nor does it reference the specific FR-005 requirement in its description text (though it mentions FR-005 in the dependency note). The task description focuses on implementation details (resetting seeds) rather than the spec's requirement to 'report the resulting variation in the mean belief rating'.

Task T005 (Fetch Data) and T004 (Construct Validity Gate) are marked as parallel [P], but T004 depends on T005's output. While this is an ordering issue, the lack of a clear [FR-NNN] tag on T004 (which validates the dataset schema) makes it difficult to trace which spec requirement mandates the specific ROI columns ('source_attribution', 'headline_body') listed in the task.
